verses.original: Καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα περιεπάτει ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐν τῇ Γαλιλαίᾳ οὐ γὰρ ἤθελεν ἐν τῇ Ἰουδαίᾳ περιπατεῖν ὅτι ἐζήτουν αὐτὸν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι ἀποκτεῖναι
verses.transliteration: Kai meta tauta periepatei ho Iēsous en tē Galilaia ou gar ēthelen en tē Ioudaia peripatein hoti ezētoun auton hoi Ioudaioi apokteinai
verses.literal: After this Jesus traveled throughout Galilee He did not want to travel in Judea because the Jews there were trying to kill Him
verses.literalPt: Depois disso, andava Jesus pela Galileia, porque não queria andar pela Judeia, visto que os judeus procuravam tirar-lhe a vida.

verses.original: ἦν δὲ ἐγγὺς ἡ ἑορτὴ τῶν Ἰουδαίων ἡ σκηνοπηγία
verses.transliteration: ēn de engys hē heortē tōn Ioudaiōn hē skēnopēgia
verses.literal: However the Jewish Feast of Tabernacles was near
verses.literalPt: Ora, a Festa dos judeus, que é a dos Tabernáculos, estava próxima.

verses.original: εἶπον οὖν πρὸς αὐτὸν οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ Μετάβηθι ἐντεῦθεν καὶ ὕπαγε εἰς τὴν Ἰουδαίαν ἵνα καὶ οἱ μαθηταί σου θεωρήσουσιν τὰ ἔργα σοῦ ἃ ποιεῖς
verses.transliteration: eipon oun pros auton hoi adelphoi autou Metabēthi enteuthen kai hypage eis tēn Ioudaian hina kai hoi mathētai sou theōrēsousin ta erga sou ha poieis
verses.literal: So Jesus’ brothers said to Him Leave here and go to Judea so that Your disciples there may see the works You are doing
verses.literalPt: Disseram-lhe, então, seus irmãos: Sai daqui e vai para a Judeia, a fim de que também teus discípulos vejam as obras que fazes;

verses.original: οὐδεὶς γάρ τι ἐν κρυπτῷ ποιεῖ καὶ ζητεῖ αὐτὸς ἐν παρρησίᾳ εἶναι εἰ ταῦτα ποιεῖς φανέρωσον σεαυτὸν τῷ κόσμῳ
verses.transliteration: oudeis gar ti en kryptō poiei kai zētei autos en parrēsia einai ei tauta poieis phanerōson seauton tō kosmō
verses.literal: For no one who wants to be known publicly acts . . . in secret Since You are doing these things show Yourself to the world
verses.literalPt: porque ninguém faz coisa alguma em oculto, quando procura ser conhecido. Já que fazes essas coisas, manifesta-te ao mundo.

verses.original: οὐδὲ γὰρ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ ἐπίστευον εἰς αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: oude gar hoi adelphoi autou episteuon eis auton
verses.literal: For even His own brothers did not believe in Him
verses.literalPt: Pois nem seus irmãos criam nele.

verses.original: Λέγει οὖν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ὁ καιρὸς ὁ ἐμὸς οὔπω πάρεστιν ὁ δὲ καιρὸς ὁ ὑμέτερος πάντοτέ ἐστιν ἕτοιμος
verses.transliteration: Legei oun autois ho Iēsous Ho kairos ho emos oupō parestin ho de kairos ho hymeteros pantote estin hetoimos
verses.literal: Therefore Jesus told them Although your time is always at hand My time has not yet come
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhes Jesus: O meu tempo ainda não é chegado, mas o vosso tempo está sempre presente.

verses.original: οὐ δύναται ὁ κόσμος μισεῖν ὑμᾶς ἐμὲ δὲ μισεῖ ὅτι ἐγὼ μαρτυρῶ περὶ αὐτοῦ ὅτι τὰ ἔργα αὐτοῦ πονηρά ἐστιν
verses.transliteration: ou dynatai ho kosmos misein hymas eme de misei hoti egō martyrō peri autou hoti ta erga autou ponēra estin
verses.literal: The world cannot hate you but it hates Me because I testify . . . . . . that its works are evil
verses.literalPt: O mundo não vos pode odiar; mas a mim odeia, porque eu dou dele testemunho, que as suas obras são más.

verses.original: ὑμεῖς ἀνάβητε εἰς τὴν ἑορτήν ἐγὼ οὐκ ἀναβαίνω εἰς τὴν ἑορτὴν ταύτην ὅτι ὁ ἐμὸς καιρὸς οὔπω πεπλήρωται
verses.transliteration: hymeis anabēte eis tēn heortēn egō ouk anabainō eis tēn heortēn tautēn hoti ho emos kairos oupō peplērōtai
verses.literal: Go up to the feast on your own I am not going up to this feast because My time has not yet come
verses.literalPt: Subi vós à festa; eu não subo ainda a essa festa, porque o meu tempo não está ainda cumprido.

verses.original: Ταῦτα δὲ εἰπὼν αὐτὸς ἔμεινεν ἐν τῇ Γαλιλαίᾳ
verses.transliteration: Tauta de eipōn autos emeinen en tē Galilaia
verses.literal: Having said this Jesus remained in Galilee
verses.literalPt: Tendo-lhes dito isso, ficou na Galileia.

verses.original: Ὡς δὲ ἀνέβησαν οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ εἰς τὴν ἑορτήν τότε καὶ αὐτὸς ἀνέβη οὐ φανερῶς ἀλλὰ ὡς ἐν κρυπτῷ
verses.transliteration: Hōs de anebēsan hoi adelphoi autou eis tēn heortēn tote kai autos anebē ou phanerōs alla hōs en kryptō
verses.literal: But after His brothers had gone up to the feast He also went not publicly but in secret
verses.literalPt: Mas, quando seus irmãos já tinham ido à festa, então, foi ele também, não publicamente, mas como em secreto.

verses.original: Οἱ οὖν Ἰουδαῖοι ἐζήτουν αὐτὸν ἐν τῇ ἑορτῇ καὶ ἔλεγον Ποῦ ἐστιν ἐκεῖνος
verses.transliteration: Hoi oun Ioudaioi ezētoun auton en tē heortē kai elegon Pou estin ekeinos
verses.literal: So the Jews were looking for Him at the feast and asking Where is He
verses.literalPt: Procurando-o, então, os judeus na festa, perguntavam: Onde está ele?

verses.original: καὶ γογγυσμὸς περὶ αὐτοῦ ἦν πολὺς ἐν τοῖς ὄχλοις οἱ μὲν ἔλεγον ὅτι Ἀγαθός ἐστιν Ἄλλοι δὲ ἔλεγον Οὔ ἀλλὰ πλανᾷ τὸν ὄχλον
verses.transliteration: kai gongysmos peri autou ēn polys en tois ochlois hoi men elegon hoti Agathos estin Alloi de elegon Ou alla plana ton ochlon
verses.literal: Many in the crowds were whispering about Him Some said He is a good man But others replied No . . . He deceives the people
verses.literalPt: Era grande a murmuração que dele se fazia entre as multidões. Uns diziam: Ele é bom; outros: Não é; antes, desencaminha o povo.

verses.original: Οὐδεὶς μέντοι παρρησίᾳ ἐλάλει περὶ αὐτοῦ διὰ τὸν φόβον τῶν Ἰουδαίων
verses.transliteration: Oudeis mentoi parrēsia elalei peri autou dia ton phobon tōn Ioudaiōn
verses.literal: Yet no one would speak publicly about Him for fear of the Jews
verses.literalPt: Entretanto, ninguém falava dele abertamente, por medo dos judeus.

verses.original: Ἤδη δὲ τῆς ἑορτῆς μεσούσης ἀνέβη Ἰησοῦς εἰς τὸ ἱερὸν καὶ ἐδίδασκεν
verses.transliteration: Ēdē de tēs heortēs mesousēs anebē Iēsous eis to hieron kai edidasken
verses.literal: About halfway through the feast Jesus went up to the temple courts and began to teach
verses.literalPt: Estando a festa já em meio, subiu Jesus ao templo e pôs-se a ensinar.

verses.original: ἐθαύμαζον οὖν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι λέγοντες Πῶς οὗτος γράμματα οἶδεν μὴ μεμαθηκώς
verses.transliteration: ethaumazon oun hoi Ioudaioi legontes Pōs houtos grammata oiden mē memathēkōs
verses.literal: The Jews were amazed and asked How did this man attain such learning without having studied
verses.literalPt: Maravilharam-se, então, os judeus, dizendo: Como sabe este letras, sem ter estudado?

verses.original: Ἀπεκρίθη οὖν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν Ἡ Ἐμὴ διδαχὴ οὐκ ἔστιν ἐμὴ ἀλλὰ τοῦ πέμψαντός με
verses.transliteration: Apekrithē oun autois ho Iēsous kai eipen HĒ Emē didachē ouk estin emē alla tou pempsantos me
verses.literal: My teaching is not My own - Jesus replied . . . . . . . . . It comes from Him who sent Me
verses.literalPt: Jesus respondeu-lhes: O meu ensino não é meu, mas daquele que me enviou.

verses.original: ἐάν τις θέλῃ τὸ θέλημα αὐτοῦ ποιεῖν γνώσεται περὶ τῆς διδαχῆς πότερον ἐκ τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐστιν ἢ ἐγὼ ἀπ’ ἐμαυτοῦ λαλῶ
verses.transliteration: ean tis thelē to thelēma autou poiein gnōsetai peri tēs didachēs poteron ek tou Theou estin ē egō ap’ emautou lalō
verses.literal: If anyone desires to do His will he will know . . . whether My teaching is from God or whether I speak on My own
verses.literalPt: Se alguém quiser fazer a vontade de Deus, há de saber se o ensino é dele ou se eu falo por mim mesmo.

verses.original: ὁ ἀφ’ ἑαυτοῦ λαλῶν τὴν δόξαν τὴν ἰδίαν ζητεῖ ὁ δὲ ζητῶν τὴν δόξαν τοῦ πέμψαντος αὐτὸν οὗτος ἀληθής ἐστιν καὶ ἀδικία ἐν αὐτῷ οὐκ ἔστιν
verses.transliteration: ho aph’ heautou lalōn tēn doxan tēn idian zētei ho de zētōn tēn doxan tou pempsantos auton houtos alēthēs estin kai adikia en autō ouk estin
verses.literal: He who speaks on his own authority seeks his own glory but He who seeks the glory of the One who sent Him is a man of truth in Him there is no falsehood
verses.literalPt: Quem fala por si mesmo busca a sua própria glória; mas quem busca a glória daquele que o enviou, este é verdadeiro, e não há nele injustiça.

verses.original: Οὐ Μωϋσῆς δέδωκεν ὑμῖν τὸν νόμον καὶ οὐδεὶς ἐξ ὑμῶν ποιεῖ τὸν νόμον τί με ζητεῖτε ἀποκτεῖναι
verses.transliteration: Ou Mōusēs dedōken hymin ton nomon kai oudeis ex hymōn poiei ton nomon ti me zēteite apokteinai
verses.literal: Has not Moses given you the law Yet not one of you keeps it Why are you trying to kill Me
verses.literalPt: Não vos deu Moisés a Lei? No entanto, nenhum de vós a cumpre. Por que procurais tirar-me a vida?

verses.original: Ἀπεκρίθη ὁ ὄχλος Δαιμόνιον ἔχεις τίς σε ζητεῖ ἀποκτεῖναι
verses.transliteration: Apekrithē ho ochlos Daimonion echeis tis se zētei apokteinai
verses.literal: You have a demon the crowd replied Who is trying to kill You
verses.literalPt: Respondeu o povo: Estás endemoninhado; quem procura tirar-te a vida?

verses.original: Ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ἓν ἔργον ἐποίησα καὶ πάντες θαυμάζετε
verses.transliteration: Apekrithē Iēsous kai eipen autois Hen ergon epoiēsa kai pantes thaumazete
verses.literal: Jesus answered . . . . . . them I did one miracle and you are all amazed
verses.literalPt: Replicou-lhes Jesus: Uma só obra fiz, e todos vós vos maravilhais.

verses.original: διὰ τοῦτο Μωϋσῆς δέδωκεν ὑμῖν τὴν περιτομήν οὐχ ὅτι ἐκ τοῦ Μωϋσέως ἐστὶν ἀλλ’ ἐκ τῶν πατέρων καὶ ἐν σαββάτῳ περιτέμνετε ἄνθρωπον
verses.transliteration: dia touto Mōusēs dedōken hymin tēn peritomēn ouch hoti ek tou Mōuseōs estin all’ ek tōn paterōn kai en sabbatō peritemnete anthrōpon
verses.literal: But because . . . Moses gave you circumcision you circumcise a boy on the Sabbath (not that it is from Moses but from the patriarchs
verses.literalPt: Moisés vos deu a circuncisão (se bem que ela não venha de Moisés, mas dos patriarcas), e no sábado circuncidais um homem.

verses.original: εἰ περιτομὴν λαμβάνει ἄνθρωπος ἐν σαββάτῳ ἵνα μὴ λυθῇ ὁ νόμος Μωϋσέως ἐμοὶ χολᾶτε ὅτι ὅλον ἄνθρωπον ὑγιῆ ἐποίησα ἐν σαββάτῳ
verses.transliteration: ei peritomēn lambanei anthrōpos en sabbatō hina mē lythē ho nomos Mōuseōs emoi cholate hoti holon anthrōpon hygiē epoiēsa en sabbatō
verses.literal: If a boy can be circumcised on the Sabbath so that the law of Moses will not be broken why are you angry with Me for making the whole man well on the Sabbath
verses.literalPt: Pois bem: se um homem recebe a circuncisão no sábado, para não violar a Lei de Moisés, como ficais indignados comigo, porque eu, no sábado, tornei um homem inteiramente são?

verses.original: μὴ κρίνετε κατ’ ὄψιν ἀλλὰ τὴν δικαίαν κρίσιν κρίνετε
verses.transliteration: mē krinete kat’ opsin alla tēn dikaian krisin krinete
verses.literal: Stop judging by outward appearances and start judging justly . . .
verses.literalPt: Não julgueis pela aparência, mas julgai segundo a reta justiça.

verses.original: Ἔλεγον οὖν τινες ἐκ τῶν Ἱεροσολυμιτῶν Οὐχ οὗτός ἐστιν ὃν ζητοῦσιν ἀποκτεῖναι
verses.transliteration: Elegon oun tines ek tōn Hierosolymitōn Ouch houtos estin hon zētousin apokteinai
verses.literal: Then some of the people of Jerusalem began to say Isn’t . . . this the man they are trying to kill
verses.literalPt: Diziam alguns de Jerusalém: Não é este aquele a quem procuram tirar a vida?

verses.original: καὶ ἴδε παρρησίᾳ λαλεῖ καὶ οὐδὲν αὐτῷ λέγουσιν Μή‿ ποτε ἀληθῶς ἔγνωσαν οἱ ἄρχοντες ὅτι οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ Χριστός
verses.transliteration: kai ide parrēsia lalei kai ouden autō legousin Mē pote alēthōs egnōsan hoi archontes hoti houtos estin ho Christos
verses.literal: Yet here He is, speaking publicly and they are not saying . . . anything to Him Have the rulers truly recognized that this is the Christ
verses.literalPt: Eis que ele fala abertamente, e nada lhe dizem. Será possível que as autoridades tenham realmente reconhecido que este homem é o Cristo?

verses.original: ἀλλὰ τοῦτον οἴδαμεν πόθεν ἐστίν ὁ δὲ Χριστὸς ὅταν ἔρχηται οὐδεὶς γινώσκει πόθεν ἐστίν
verses.transliteration: alla touton oidamen pothen estin ho de Christos hotan erchētai oudeis ginōskei pothen estin
verses.literal: But we know where this man is from When the Christ comes no one will know where He is from
verses.literalPt: Nós, todavia, sabemos donde este é; mas, quando vier o Cristo, ninguém saberá donde ele é.

verses.original: Ἔκραξεν οὖν ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ διδάσκων ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ λέγων Κἀμὲ οἴδατε καὶ οἴδατε πόθεν εἰμί καὶ ἀπ’ ἐμαυτοῦ οὐκ ἐλήλυθα ἀλλ’ ἔστιν ἀληθινὸς ὁ πέμψας με ὃν ὑμεῖς οὐκ οἴδατε
verses.transliteration: Ekraxen oun en tō hierō didaskōn ho Iēsous kai legōn Kame oidate kai oidate pothen eimi kai ap’ emautou ouk elēlytha all’ estin alēthinos ho pempsas me hon hymeis ouk oidate
verses.literal: Then Jesus still teaching in the temple courts cried out . . . . . . You know Me and you know where I am from I have not come of My own accord but He who sent Me is true You do not know Him
verses.literalPt: Então, Jesus levantou a voz no templo, ensinando e dizendo: Vós não somente me conheceis, mas também sabeis donde eu sou; e eu não vim de mim mesmo, mas é verdadeiro aquele que me enviou, a quem vós não conheceis.

verses.original: ἐγὼ οἶδα αὐτόν ὅτι παρ’ αὐτοῦ εἰμι κἀκεῖνός με ἀπέστειλεν
verses.transliteration: egō oida auton hoti par’ autou eimi kakeinos me apesteilen
verses.literal: but I know Him because I am from Him and He sent Me
verses.literalPt: Eu o conheço, porque venho dele, e ele me enviou.

verses.original: Ἐζήτουν οὖν αὐτὸν πιάσαι καὶ οὐδεὶς ἐπέβαλεν ἐπ’ αὐτὸν τὴν χεῖρα ὅτι οὔπω ἐληλύθει ἡ ὥρα αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Ezētoun oun auton piasai kai oudeis epebalen ep’ auton tēn cheira hoti oupō elēlythei hē hōra autou
verses.literal: So they tried to seize Him but no one laid a hand on Him because His hour had not yet come
verses.literalPt: Procuravam, então, prendê-lo; mas ninguém pôs as mãos nele, porque ainda não era chegada a sua hora.

verses.original: Ἐκ τοῦ ὄχλου δὲ πολλοὶ ἐπίστευσαν εἰς αὐτόν καὶ ἔλεγον Ὁ Χριστὸς ὅταν ἔλθῃ μὴ πλείονα σημεῖα ποιήσει ὧν οὗτος ἐποίησεν
verses.transliteration: Ek tou ochlou de polloi episteusan eis auton kai elegon Ho Christos hotan elthē mē pleiona sēmeia poiēsei hōn houtos epoiēsen
verses.literal: Many in the crowd however believed in Him and said When the Christ comes will He perform more signs than this man
verses.literalPt: Mas muitos do povo creram nele e diziam: Quando o Cristo vier, fará mais milagres do que este homem tem feito?

verses.original: Ἤκουσαν οἱ Φαρισαῖοι τοῦ ὄχλου γογγύζοντος περὶ αὐτοῦ ταῦτα καὶ ἀπέστειλαν οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ Φαρισαῖοι ὑπηρέτας ἵνα πιάσωσιν αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Ēkousan hoi Pharisaioi tou ochlou gongyzontos peri autou tauta kai apesteilan hoi archiereis kai hoi Pharisaioi hypēretas hina piasōsin auton
verses.literal: When the Pharisees heard the crowd whispering these things about Jesus - they and the chief priests sent officers to arrest Him
verses.literalPt: Os fariseus ouviram murmurar a multidão essas coisas a respeito dele, e os principais sacerdotes e os fariseus mandaram os oficiais de justiça para o prender.

verses.original: εἶπεν οὖν ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ἔτι χρόνον μικρὸν μεθ’ ὑμῶν εἰμι καὶ ὑπάγω πρὸς τὸν πέμψαντά με
verses.transliteration: eipen oun ho Iēsous Eti chronon mikron meth’ hymōn eimi kai hypagō pros ton pempsanta me
verses.literal: So Jesus said I am with you only a little while longer and then I am going to the One who sent Me
verses.literalPt: Mas disse Jesus: Ainda por um pouco de tempo estou convosco; depois, vou para aquele que me enviou.

verses.original: ζητήσετέ με καὶ οὐχ εὑρήσετέ με καὶ ὅπου εἰμὶ ἐγὼ ὑμεῖς οὐ δύνασθε ἐλθεῖν
verses.transliteration: zētēsete me kai ouch heurēsete me kai hopou eimi egō hymeis ou dynasthe elthein
verses.literal: You will look for Me but you will not find Me and where I am you cannot come
verses.literalPt: Procurar-me-eis e não me achareis; e, onde eu estiver, vós não podeis ir.

verses.original: Εἶπον οὖν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι πρὸς ἑαυτούς Ποῦ οὗτος μέλλει πορεύεσθαι ὅτι ἡμεῖς οὐχ εὑρήσομεν αὐτόν μὴ εἰς τὴν Διασπορὰν τῶν Ἑλλήνων μέλλει πορεύεσθαι καὶ διδάσκειν τοὺς Ἕλληνας
verses.transliteration: Eipon oun hoi Ioudaioi pros heautous Pou houtos mellei poreuesthai hoti hēmeis ouch heurēsomen auton mē eis tēn Diasporan tōn Hellēnōn mellei poreuesthai kai didaskein tous Hellēnas
verses.literal: At this the Jews said to one another Where does He intend to go that we will not find Him Will He go where the Jews are dispersed among the Greeks and teach the Greeks
verses.literalPt: Perguntaram, pois, os judeus entre si: Onde irá este que não o acharemos? Acaso, irá à Dispersão entre os gregos e ensinará os gregos?

verses.original: τίς ἐστιν ὁ λόγος οὗτος ὃν εἶπεν Ζητήσετέ με καὶ οὐχ εὑρήσετέ με καὶ Ὅπου εἰμὶ ἐγὼ ὑμεῖς οὐ δύνασθε ἐλθεῖν
verses.transliteration: tis estin ho logos houtos hon eipen Zētēsete me kai ouch heurēsete me kai Hopou eimi egō hymeis ou dynasthe elthein
verses.literal: What does He mean by saying You will look for Me but you will not find Me and Where I am you cannot come
verses.literalPt: Que palavras são estas que ele disse: Procurar-me-eis e não me achareis; e onde eu estiver, vós não podeis ir?

verses.original: Ἐν δὲ τῇ ἐσχάτῃ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ μεγάλῃ τῆς ἑορτῆς εἱστήκει ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ ἔκραξεν λέγων Ἐάν τις διψᾷ ἐρχέσθω πρός με καὶ πινέτω
verses.transliteration: En de tē eschatē hēmera tē megalē tēs heortēs heistēkei ho Iēsous kai ekraxen legōn Ean tis dipsa erchesthō pros me kai pinetō
verses.literal: On the last and greatest day of the feast Jesus stood up and called out in a loud voice . . . If anyone is thirsty let him come to Me and drink
verses.literalPt: No último, no grande dia da festa, levantou-se Jesus e exclamou: Se alguém tiver sede, venha a mim e beba.

verses.original: ὁ πιστεύων εἰς ἐμέ καθὼς εἶπεν ἡ γραφή Ποταμοὶ ἐκ τῆς κοιλίας αὐτοῦ ῥεύσουσιν ὕδατος ζῶντος
verses.transliteration: ho pisteuōn eis eme kathōs eipen hē graphē Potamoi ek tēs koilias autou rheusousin hydatos zōntos
verses.literal: Whoever believes in Me as the Scripture has said Streams of living water will flow from within him
verses.literalPt: Quem crê em mim, como disse a Escritura, do seu interior manarão rios de água viva.

verses.original: τοῦτο δὲ εἶπεν περὶ τοῦ Πνεύματος οὗ ἔμελλον λαμβάνειν οἱ πιστεύσαντες εἰς αὐτόν οὔπω γὰρ ἦν Πνεῦμα ὅτι Ἰησοῦς οὐδέπω ἐδοξάσθη
verses.transliteration: touto de eipen peri tou Pneumatos hou emellon lambanein hoi pisteusantes eis auton oupō gar ēn Pneuma hoti Iēsous oudepō edoxasthē
verses.literal: He was speaking about the Spirit whom those who believed in Him were later to receive For the Spirit had not yet been given because Jesus had not yet been glorified
verses.literalPt: Disse isso a respeito do Espírito que iam receber os que nele criam; pois o Espírito ainda não fora dado, porque Jesus não havia sido ainda glorificado.

verses.original: Ἐκ τοῦ ὄχλου οὖν ἀκούσαντες τῶν λόγων τούτων ἔλεγον Οὗτός ἐστιν ἀληθῶς ὁ προφήτης
verses.transliteration: Ek tou ochlou oun akousantes tōn logōn toutōn elegon Houtos estin alēthōs ho prophētēs
verses.literal: On hearing these words some of the people said This is truly the Prophet
verses.literalPt: Então, alguns dentre o povo que tinham ouvido estas palavras diziam: Este homem é realmente o profeta;

verses.original: Ἄλλοι ἔλεγον Οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ Χριστός Οἱ δὲ ἔλεγον Μὴ γὰρ ἐκ τῆς Γαλιλαίας ὁ Χριστὸς ἔρχεται
verses.transliteration: Alloi elegon Houtos estin ho Christos Hoi de elegon Mē gar ek tēs Galilaias ho Christos erchetai
verses.literal: Others declared This is the Christ But still others asked How can the Christ come from Galilee
verses.literalPt: outros: Este é o Cristo; outros, porém, perguntavam: Pois da Galileia é que vem o Cristo?

verses.original: οὐχ ἡ γραφὴ εἶπεν ὅτι ἐκ τοῦ σπέρματος Δαυὶδ καὶ ἀπὸ Βηθλεὲμ τῆς κώμης ὅπου ἦν Δαυὶδ ἔρχεται ὁ Χριστός
verses.transliteration: ouch hē graphē eipen hoti ek tou spermatos Dauid kai apo Bēthleem tēs kōmēs hopou ēn Dauid erchetai ho Christos
verses.literal: Doesn’t the Scripture say that the Christ will come from the line of David and from Bethlehem the village where David lived
verses.literalPt: Não declarou a Escritura que o Cristo vem da descendência de Davi e da aldeia de Belém, donde era Davi?

verses.original: Σχίσμα οὖν ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ ὄχλῳ δι’ αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Schisma oun egeneto en tō ochlō di’ auton
verses.literal: So there was division in the crowd because of Jesus
verses.literalPt: Assim, houve uma dissensão entre o povo por causa dele;

verses.original: τινὲς δὲ ἤθελον ἐξ αὐτῶν πιάσαι αὐτόν ἀλλ’ οὐδεὶς ἐπέβαλεν ἐπ’ αὐτὸν τὰς χεῖρας
verses.transliteration: tines de ēthelon ex autōn piasai auton all’ oudeis epebalen ep’ auton tas cheiras
verses.literal: Some of them wanted to seize Him but no one laid a hand on Him
verses.literalPt: alguns queriam prendê-lo, mas ninguém lhe pôs as mãos.

verses.original: Ἦλθον οὖν οἱ ὑπηρέται πρὸς τοὺς ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ Φαρισαίους καὶ εἶπον αὐτοῖς ἐκεῖνοι Διὰ τί οὐκ ἠγάγετε αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Ēlthon oun hoi hypēretai pros tous archiereis kai Pharisaious kai eipon autois ekeinoi Dia ti ouk ēgagete auton
verses.literal: Then the officers returned to the chief priests and Pharisees who asked them Why . . . didn’t you bring Him in
verses.literalPt: Voltaram, então, os oficiais de justiça aos principais sacerdotes e fariseus, e estes lhes perguntaram: Por que não o trouxestes?

verses.original: Ἀπεκρίθησαν οἱ ὑπηρέται Οὐδέποτε ἐλάλησεν οὕτως ἄνθρωπος ὡς οὗτος λαλεῖ ὁ ἄνθρωπος
verses.transliteration: Apekrithēsan hoi hypēretai Oudepote elalēsen houtōs anthrōpos hōs houtos lalei ho anthrōpos
verses.literal: Never has anyone spoken like this man the officers answered
verses.literalPt: Responderam os oficiais: Nunca homem algum falou como esse homem.

verses.original: Ἀπεκρίθησαν οὖν αὐτοῖς οἱ Φαρισαῖοι Μὴ καὶ ὑμεῖς πεπλάνησθε
verses.transliteration: Apekrithēsan oun autois hoi Pharisaioi Mē kai hymeis peplanēsthe
verses.literal: Have you also been deceived replied the Pharisees
verses.literalPt: Replicaram-lhes os fariseus: Estais vós também iludidos?

verses.original: μή τις ἐκ τῶν ἀρχόντων ἐπίστευσεν εἰς αὐτὸν ἢ ἐκ τῶν Φαρισαίων
verses.transliteration: mē tis ek tōn archontōn episteusen eis auton ē ek tōn Pharisaiōn
verses.literal: Have any of the rulers or - Pharisees believed in Him
verses.literalPt: Porventura, creu nele alguma das autoridades ou alguns dos fariseus?

verses.original: ἀλλὰ ὁ ὄχλος οὗτος ὁ μὴ γινώσκων τὸν νόμον ἐπάρατοί εἰσιν
verses.transliteration: alla ho ochlos houtos ho mē ginōskōn ton nomon eparatoi eisin
verses.literal: But this crowd that does not know the law they are under a curse
verses.literalPt: Mas este povo que não entende a Lei é amaldiçoado.

verses.original: Λέγει Νικόδημος πρὸς αὐτούς ὁ ἐλθὼν πρὸς αὐτὸν τὸ πρότερον εἷς ὢν ἐξ αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: Legei Nikodēmos pros autous ho elthōn pros auton to proteron heis ōn ex autōn
verses.literal: Nicodemus who had gone to Jesus earlier and who himself was one of them asked
verses.literalPt: Nicodemos, um deles, que antes fora ter com Jesus, perguntou-lhes:

verses.original: Μὴ ὁ νόμος ἡμῶν κρίνει τὸν ἄνθρωπον ἐὰν μὴ ἀκούσῃ πρῶτον παρ’ αὐτοῦ καὶ γνῷ τί ποιεῖ
verses.transliteration: Mē ho nomos hēmōn krinei ton anthrōpon ean mē akousē prōton par’ autou kai gnō ti poiei
verses.literal: Does our law convict a man without first hearing from him to determine what he has done
verses.literalPt: Porventura, julga a nossa lei a alguém, sem primeiro ouvi-lo e saber o que ele faz?

verses.original: Ἀπεκρίθησαν καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ Μὴ καὶ σὺ ἐκ τῆς Γαλιλαίας εἶ ἐραύνησον καὶ ἴδε ὅτι ἐκ τῆς Γαλιλαίας προφήτης οὐκ ἐγείρεται
verses.transliteration: Apekrithēsan kai eipan autō Mē kai sy ek tēs Galilaias ei eraunēson kai ide hoti ek tēs Galilaias prophētēs ouk egeiretai
verses.literal: Aren’t . . . you also from Galilee they replied . . . . . . . . . Look into it and you will see that no prophet comes out of Galilee
verses.literalPt: Eles lhe responderam: És tu também da Galileia? Examina e vê que da Galileia não se levanta profeta.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐπορεύθησαν ἕκαστος εἰς τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Kai eporeuthēsan hekastos eis ton oikon autou
verses.literal: Then each went to his own home
verses.literalPt: [Cada um foi para sua casa;
